latest_autonomous_wave.title: Crash-Resumable Long-Track Output Transfer
latest_autonomous_wave.goal: Reduce MOI-P021 long-track failure cost by safely resuming a large provider stem download after network/process interruption instead of deleting all staging progress and redownloading from byte zero.
latest_autonomous_wave.rationale: A15 already bounded memory, disk, output size and transfer concurrency, but inherited output collection deletes ephemeral staging on every retry/failure. For long stems this converts a relaunch or transient network failure into repeated full transfer cost. A41 preserves only validator-bound bytes outside staging and re-materializes them without a second full copy.
latest_autonomous_wave.done_when: Default HTTPS output transfer may reuse an interrupted prefix only with strong ETag, known total length, exact Range/Content-Range continuity and unchanged signed-URL reference; all ambiguity fails closed or restarts from zero; normal budgeted production uses the A41 wrapper; regression/evidence/status are durable without claiming P021 parity.
